admission.justification: Each member protects one way the single-coordinator handover can fail: the role texts alone could disagree with the router and the operation, the manifest could still describe the old default, the host handover could tell a parented Manager to relay, the developer's answer-first duty is what keeps the developer in charge, and the closeout exception is the one execution step the retained Architect keeps; only together do they make one coherent default.

guarantee: Across role/operation/router/manifest and host handover sources, a delegating Architect hands coordination to one Manager for one master or one Orchestrator across concurrent masters, with one Manager per master. That coordinator decides non-developer work and sends authored cognitive reports only on the four developer-needed categories and final report occasion; native plugin turn-end metadata is a nonsemantic wake signal, not a ruling, verdict or acceptance. Developer-chosen direct coordination and a single-master Orchestrator remain the only named exceptions, and Architect keeps the developer conversation, answer-first duty and narrow paired-closeout exception.
title: One coordinating agent under the architect
